unresolved_high_value_clusters.family: image_copy selectors with explicit format/dimension CTS preconditions
unresolved_high_value_clusters.evidence: Pinned source for every selector calls ImageCopyTest.skipIfTextureFormatNotSupported(format); 198 also call skipIfTextureFormatAndDimensionNotCompatible(format,dimension). CTS therefore skips formats/dimensions the adapter does not expose. This means per-device applicability is conditional, not a universal FL9_1 guarantee or universal native absence. For each selector, the DXGI required-format table determines mandatory vs optional format guarantees; the adapter’s actual CheckFormatSupport determines optional-format applicability. Existing fails-if(dx11) remains until gate outcome and physical result are recorded.
unresolved_high_value_clusters.disposition: DRIVER/FORMAT-CONDITIONAL; backend outcome unresolved. First probes should use a required format (RGBA8_UNORM) and single-layer 2D; then compare required D16_UNORM/R32_FLOAT and optional format gated cases.
